data.name: Business And Life Simulator
data.detailed_description:
BUSINESS AND LIFE SIMULATOR

Build your own business. Create the biggest business empire in the city. But be careful... Your friends are in the same city.

How will you play?

A hardworking entrepreneur?
A smart investor?
A ruthless competitor?
Or an opportunist waiting to rob your friends' cash registers?

Business And Life Simulator is a simulation game that combines business management, economics, competition, and everyday life, playable either solo or with 1-4 players.

Start with a small shop and turn it into a business empire, or build your own economic world together with your friends. But in this world, everyone has to make their own money... and sometimes, making money isn't just about working hard.

🏪 BUILD YOUR OWN BUSINESS

Choose your business and start growing:

  • 🚗 Car Dealership – Buy and sell vehicles, manage your inventory, and hunt for more valuable cars.

  • 🛒 Supermarket – Purchase products, stock your shelves, set your prices, and keep your customers happy.

  • 👕 Boutique – Choose your clothing, customize your store, and attract your customers.

  • 💊 Pharmacy – Manage your products, control your inventory, and grow your business.

Each business has its own products, economy, and progression system. Use the money you earn wisely to unlock bigger stores, better equipment, and more products.

💰 MAKING MONEY ISN'T ENOUGH

While growing your business, how you manage your money matters too.

Use your tablet to make investments, put your money into different opportunities, and try to increase your profits.

The right investment can bring you huge returns. The wrong decision can turn your entire plan upside down.

🤝 WORK WITH YOUR FRIENDS... OR SABOTAGE THEIR BUSINESS

In the world of Business And Life Simulator, your friends aren't just your teammates — they can also be your competitors.

You can lend money to each other, make interest-based deals, and build your own financial relationships.

But things don't always have to stay friendly.

If your friend's cash register is fuller than yours, why shouldn't it be yours?

Make a plan, watch for opportunities, and strike at the right moment. To succeed, you need to be more than a good business owner — sometimes, you need to be a great strategist.

👥 1-4 PLAYERS

Build your own empire alone, or play together with 1-4 players.

Develop your businesses in the same world, trade with each other, lend and borrow money, make investments, and compete in an evolving economy.

You can become rich together...

Or become each other's biggest rivals.

📈 FROM A SMALL SHOP TO A BUSINESS EMPIRE

Every dollar you earn is a new opportunity.

Upgrade your business, purchase more products, manage your inventory, invest your money, and put your profits back into your business.

The goal isn't just to make money.

It's to become the most successful business owner in the city.

Business And Life Simulator — Build Your Business. Shape Your Life.
